mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a language that is used to communicate between the browser and web server."
HTTP is a language that is used to communicate between the browser and web server.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of rules that governs the communications between computers on a network."
A protocol is a set of rules that governs the communications between computers on a network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to transfer (upload/download) data from one computer to another over the internet or through or computer network."
FTP or file transfer protocol is used to transfer (upload/download) data from one computer to another over the internet or through or computer network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to eliminate network downtime caused by a single point of failure."
The redundant topologies are used to eliminate network downtime caused by a single point of failure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very popular local area network architecture based on the CSMA/CD access method."
Basis and Working Ethernet is a very popular local area network architecture based on the CSMA/CD access method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of reconstructing the segmented data units."
Reassembly is the process of reconstructing the segmented data units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the combination of the different protocols."
Protocols stacks refer to the combination of the different protocols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an international standard, originally established by the ITU in 1984, for transmitting digital data over the PSTN."
ISDN (Integrated Services Digital Network) is an international standard, originally established by the ITU in 1984, for transmitting digital data over the PSTN.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to carry the communications signals: copper wire, fibre-optic cables and wireless or radio transmissions etc."
Various media are used to carry the communications signals: copper wire, fibre-optic cables and wireless or radio transmissions etc.

HDLC is used both half-duplex and full-duplex communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a protocol that is used to send the email messages between the servers."
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol is a protocol that is used to send the email messages between the servers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of interconnected systems sharing resources and interacting using a shared communications link."
A network of computers is a group of interconnected systems sharing resources and interacting using a shared communications link.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a seven-layered standard, but TCP/IP is a four layered standard."
OSI is a seven-layered standard, but TCP/IP is a four layered standard.

Timing refers to two characteristics: when data should be sent and how fast they can be sent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in straight-through cable to connect Ethernet devices."
Four wires are used in straight-through cable to connect Ethernet devices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in the virtual private networks."
The point to point tunneling protocol is used in the virtual private networks.

SMTP is a simple, text based protocol and one or more recipient of the message is specified and then the message is transferred.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a numeric identifier assigned to each machine on an IP network."
An IP address is a numeric identifier assigned to each machine on an IP network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine the logical address when the physical address is known."
Reverse address resolution protocol (RARP) is used to determine the logical address when the physical address is known.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a four-layered structure resting on a common hardware platform."
TCP/IP model is a four-layered structure resting on a common hardware platform.

The user datagram protocol is a most important protocol of the TCP/IP suite and is used to send the short messages known as datagram.

FDDI is an ANSI standard network and it can support 500 stations in 2 kilometers.

Transport Layer is the third layer of the four layer TCP/IP model.

IPX is a network layer protocol used for connectionless communication where as SPX is a transport layer protocol used for connection-oriented communication.

Star topology is a LAN topology in which endpoints on a network are connected to a common central switch or hub by point-to-point links.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the top most layer of four layer TCP/IP model."
Application layer is the top most layer of four layer TCP/IP model.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the medium through which information usually moves from one network device to another."
Cable is the medium through which information usually moves from one network device to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a most commonly communication protocol for transferring the files over the internet."
FTP is a most commonly communication protocol for transferring the files over the internet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called CSMA/CA (Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Avoidance)."
The method used by LocalTalk is called CSMA/CA (Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Avoidance).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unreliable connectionless protocol that operates on the transport layer and it is sometimes called Universal Datagram Protocol."
UDP is an unreliable connectionless protocol that operates on the transport layer and it is sometimes called Universal Datagram Protocol.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the concept of sharing resources and services."
Networking is the concept of sharing resources and services.

Scattered infrared communication is a broadcast of infrared transmissions sent out in multiple directions that bounces off walls and ceilings until it eventually hits the receiver.

TCP/IP is an industry standard set of protocols developed by the U.S.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with controlling the operation of the subnet."
The Network Layer The network layer is concerned with controlling the operation of the subnet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rate of information arriving at, and possibly passing through, a particular point in a network."
The throughput rate is the rate of information arriving at, and possibly passing through, a particular point in a network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very simple file transfer protocol with the very basic features of the FTP."
Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) is a very simple file transfer protocol with the very basic features of the FTP.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most popular and is generally the best option for school networks (See fig. 4.3.1)."
Unshielded twisted pair (UTP) is the most popular and is generally the best option for school networks (See fig. 4.3.1).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special computer dedicated to switching packets."
A router is a special computer dedicated to switching packets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a six-character sequence unique to each vendor."
The Block ID is a six-character sequence unique to each vendor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technology standard maintained by the International Standards Organization (ISO)."
The OSI model is a technology standard maintained by the International Standards Organization (ISO).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a networking technology originally developed at Xerox in the early 1970s and improved by Digital Equipment Corporation, Intel, and Xerox."
Ethernet is a networking technology originally developed at Xerox in the early 1970s and improved by Digital Equipment Corporation, Intel, and Xerox.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to describe this speed: throughput rate and bandwidth."
Two terms are used to describe this speed: throughput rate and bandwidth.
